registered: 2026-09-26, Kiro, branch kiro/zone-owncam-memory; committed together with the memory source BEFORE any memory ON or OFF episode of this experiment ran. The test source is frozen separately (frozen_source.json) before the test split.
question: Does an own-camera observation memory ('look once, remember') reduce the SIM time an M1 own-camera delivery spends looking around, without losing M1 success or adding false confirmations, compared with the unchanged baseline on the same new seeds?

conditions.off: harness/m1_owncam_delivery.py M1OwnCamDelivery, the frozen M1 student (PR #201, frozen ca2fdb8 hashes), no memory
conditions.memory_v1: harness/m1_owncam_memory.py M1OwnCamDeliveryMem = the same student + harness/owncam_memory.py (one memory per robot, own inputs only) + harness/owncam_drive_mem.py look policy

same_for_both: physics runner scripts/run_m1_owncam.run (via scripts/run_m1_owncam_memory.py), skill v9, calibration experiments/2026-09-26-zone-m1-owncam/calibration_m1_dev.json, pose source owncam_pf_v2, pose limits and gate rules of M1, contact profile cargo_noslip_v1 (approved by the user 2026-09-26), weld OFF, sync SIM (timestep as built), own robot_cam 5 Hz, SIM limit 720 s, map zone_wide_door_tags_v1, identical seeds/spawn/slot/boxes

student.map_note: develop on zone_wide_door_tags_v1 (the study scenario map family; v1 has wall tags at 0.05 m only, no door posts). The M1 baseline was validated on tags_v2; its behaviour on v1 is part of this comparison.

memory_model_calibration: the view model's detection table (tag side / obliquity -> detection probability), the held-box image band and the strict expectation margins were set from OWN inputs of the M1 test episodes s102/s105 (recorded frames, own PF estimates, own detections; no GT) and checked on s101/s106 (outputs/m1-owncam-20260926/test). No episode of this experiment was used.
primary_metric: per test seed, SIM makespan (result.sim_s) of memory_v1 minus off, over the seeds where both conditions reach m1_success; reported with both conditions' m1_success k/6
claim_rule: memory ON is reported as faster only if (a) m1_success(memory_v1) >= m1_success(off) on the 6 test seeds, (b) false_success == 0 in memory_v1, (c) at least 3 seeds succeed in both conditions and memory_v1 is faster on every one of them. Otherwise report the numbers without a claim.
secondary: looks: LOOK_P20 look sweeps (entries into the look posture from the issued commands), pan dwell positions, time in the look posture, search sweeps and their pans
evaluation-only localization error (eval_only/frames_eval.jsonl): p50/p90 position and yaw error over all initialized frames and at the look-back / placement gate frames

false confirmations: M1 false_success (both conditions); memory_v1 only: confirmed box tracks with no GT box of that kind within 0.10 m at confirmation, the chosen target track's GT error > 0.10 m, and remembered-free cells (log-odds <= -0.6 at the end) within 0.05 m of a non-target GT box
memory decisions: short / full / skipped looks, early stops, escalations, expected-view-missing events, skipped viewpoints and pans, re-verifications, slot checks
wall time and load average (sync SIM: not a result)

stop_rule.episode: M1 controller / skill outcome or SIM 720 s (the frozen runner)
stop_rule.dev: dev seeds 151-152 may be rerun while debugging memory_v1; every attempt is kept in its own output folder and reported; fixes go into prereg_amendments.json (student side only) before the freeze
stop_rule.test: seeds 161-166 run ONCE per condition on the frozen source (frozen_source.json); both conditions of one seed run concurrently (at most 2 sims)
stop_rule.exclusion: only an infrastructure failure (killed process / host error with no result.json) may be rerun once, kept and labelled; a controller, skill or runner exception with result.json counts as a failed episode

guards: thread caps OMP/OPENBLAS/VECLIB/MKL=1 enforced by the runner; >= 30 GiB free on the output disk before every episode; load average recorded per episode; no live LLM/API calls; GT only in eval_only/
map_v3_rule: if kiro/zone-map-v3 publishes a passing own-camera localization gate for zone_wide_door_tags_v3 before this test cohort finishes, the same 6 test seeds are also run on v3 for both conditions as a secondary comparison; otherwise v3 is reported as not compared
